description: Resmî makro veriyle, doğrulanmış ekonometrik yöntemleri tarayıcıda çalıştıran açık kaynak araç.
descriptionEnglish: An open-source tool for running validated econometric methods on official macroeconomic data in your browser.
warning: Beta; yanlış öncüllü sorularda güvenilir değil.
warningEnglish: Beta; unreliable on questions with false premises.
status: Feature development is frozen. Maintenance fixes only.
evaluationScope: These are measurements of local research candidates, not of the currently deployed search engine. The failed general-correction candidate was not deployed. Retests are observed development evidence, not new independent validation. Source references were AI-curated, not independently human-validated.
limitations: A Found label does not validate the question's premise. Direction, permanence, targeting and variable/mechanism claims can escape the checks.
Multiple dates, report periods and publication dates may be resolved incompletely. Verify the period on the official source.
Relevant evidence may remain only under Related; weak word overlap can miss an existing source.
Selected extracts are not complete reports. Rationale, timing, eligibility and other conditions may be absent. Missing evidence does not establish that an event did not occur.
The tool returns original quotations, not a generated economic explanation or a reliable automated fact-check. Check the date, instrument, actor and qualifiers yourself.
